sources.title: Sarvam AI - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Sarvam AI (lit. 'all' or 'wholeness') [1] is an Indian artificial intelligence company headquartered in Bengaluru, Karnataka. Founded in 2023, the company develops large language models (LLMs) such as Indus [2] and multimodal AI systems with a focus on Indian languages and region-specific use cases. sources.snippet: Sarvam is India's full-stack sovereign AI platform, with speech-to-text, text-to-speech, translation, and conversational agents across 22 Indian languages. Start free.
